scientific_integrity: Universal proof via a Fejer-square certificate and Fourier inversion; deterministic reproducibility tests complement but do not replace proof. Historical independent corroboration remains incomplete.
scientific_limitations: Exact Gaussian harmonic dynamics, full momentum refresh, iid bounded trajectory durations with fixed mean, arithmetic frequencies and centered quadratic statistics only. General spectra, discretization and computational cost per gradient call are outside scope.
title: Sharp roots-of-unity trajectory laws for quadratic mixing in Gaussian Hamiltonian Monte Carlo
